triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: There’s such a difference between fifteen and eleven that brothers are never companions at those ages.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Am I my brother Dmitri’s keeper?” Ivan snapped irritably, but then he suddenly smiled bitterly.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: “I do love you, Ivan. Dmitri says of you—Ivan is a tomb! I say of you, Ivan is a riddle.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Ah, she knew how I loved her! She loved me and not Dmitri,” Ivan insisted gayly.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: She loved me and not Dmitri,” Ivan insisted gayly.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Do you imagine I am jealous of Dmitri, that I’ve been trying to steal his beautiful Katerina Ivanovna for the last three months?

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: It’s a feature of the Karamazovs, it’s true, that thirst for life regardless of everything; you have it no doubt too

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: It’s a feature of the Karamazovs, it’s true, that thirst for life regardless of everything; you have it no doubt too

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: I don’t want to wound my little brother who has been watching me with such expectation for three months.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: “No, brother, we had better not drink,” said Alyosha suddenly.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: To talk of my love for Katerina Ivanovna, of the old man and Dmitri? of foreign travel? of the fatal position of Russia?
